CREATE TABLE "appdb"."public"."users" (
    "id" integer NOT NULL,
    "account_id" integer NOT NULL,
    "email" text,
    "role" text,
    "created_at" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    "deleted_at" timestamp with time zone,
    PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

CREATE TABLE "appdb"."public"."accounts" (
    "id" integer NOT NULL,
    "name" text NOT NULL,
    "plan" text,
    "plan_tier" text,
    "is_test" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    "country" text,
    "currency" text,
    "created_at" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    "deleted_at" timestamp with time zone,
    PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

CREATE TABLE "appdb"."public"."subscriptions" (
    "id" integer NOT NULL,
    "account_id" integer NOT NULL,
    "plan_tier" text NOT NULL,
    "status" text NOT NULL,
    "started_at" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    "trial_ends_at" timestamp with time zone,
    "canceled_at" timestamp with time zone,
    "cancel_reason" text,
    PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

CREATE TABLE "appdb"."public"."invoices" (
    "id" integer NOT NULL,
    "subscription_id" integer NOT NULL,
    "account_id" integer NOT NULL,
    "amount_cents" integer NOT NULL,
    "currency" text NOT NULL,
    "status" text NOT NULL,
    "issued_at" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    "paid_at" timestamp with time zone,
    PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

CREATE TABLE "appdb"."public"."refunds" (
    "id" integer NOT NULL,
    "invoice_id" integer NOT NULL,
    "amount_cents" integer NOT NULL,
    "created_at" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

CREATE TABLE "appdb"."public"."events" (
    "id" integer NOT NULL,
    "account_id" integer NOT NULL,
    "user_id" integer NOT NULL,
    "event_type" text NOT NULL,
    "occurred_at" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);
